facts.fact: La Nation reports that the Republic of Djibouti joined (adhere) the EARDIP regional project, to develop terrestrial fibre along the northern road corridor, and that a stakeholder workshop on its grievance mechanism was held on 29 July 2025; the joining date is not given.
